problem.title: IMLS-SLAM KITTI Odom seq 05 full (2761 frames): held-out check of the paper pipeline
problem.question: Does the IMLS-SLAM paper pipeline, with the values chosen on seq 07 (00 held out), stay near the paper's per-sequence KITTI Odometry error (official RTE) on seq 05?

variants.label: IMLS-SLAM paper odometry, window 100, coarse start on the first registration
variants.intent: As paper_odometry_w100, plus one coarse stage (r = 1.0 m, h = 0.3 m, 10 iterations) before the paper's iterations on the first registration only, where the constant-velocity guess is zero. Not in the paper; it matters only for sequences that start in motion (KITTI 04: 11.9 -> 0.43 %).
variants.note: IMLS-SLAM paper odometry (raw scans, window of 100 raw scans, h=0.1 r=0.2, nine lists x 100, 20 iterations); no GT seed. mean samples 900.0; coarse start on the first 1 registrations (r=1.0 h=0.3, not in the paper)
variants.readability_note: Adds extra tuning knobs and therefore more command complexity.
variants.extensibility_note: Still stable-interface compatible, but with a larger parameter surface.
variants.decision_reason: Best combined benchmark score on the shared dataset and interface.
